data.body: Reviewer provenance for Gerrit 3086 merged SHA b10a2309d65b4128c30dd7839a6d9905b8158e63: the code edits and signed commit were prepared by the primary agent /root. Independent background agent /root/resume_group02 inspected the 67 exact merged-SHA prose blocks, checked strict shrink, normalized AST/directives, and preserved contract or consumer, then posted the 67-row TSV receipt. Each row's reviewer_session is agent:/root/resume_group02:2026-10-23. The tracker and Git account are shared Rebar Bot transport credentials, so both comments have the same ticket author_id; they do not identify the agent who performed the review.
